rules.statement: Only the owner of an apiary may add hives to it.
rules.subject: hive registration (apiary owner)

rules.statement: Only the owner of a hive may record inspections for it.
rules.subject: inspection recording (hive owner)

rules.statement: The number of brood frames in an inspection must be a whole number of zero or more.
rules.subject: inspection brood frames

rules.statement: Colony temperament must be rated as a whole number of at least 1.
rules.subject: inspection temperament score

rules.statement: Colony temperament must be rated as a whole number of at most 5.
rules.subject: inspection temperament score

rules.statement: The varroa mite count per 100 bees must be a finite number of zero or more.
rules.subject: inspection varroa mites per 100 bees

rules.statement: A hive is flagged as needing treatment when an inspection finds a varroa count above the treatment threshold.
rules.subject: hive needs-treatment flag (varroa mites per 100 bees)

evidence.quote: if (treatmentStarts.some((s) => s >= since && s < at)) flaggedSince = null;

rules.statement: A hive's needs-treatment flag clears only when a treatment starts on or after the high-mite inspection and before a later inspection at or below the threshold.
rules.subject: clearing the hive needs-treatment flag
